verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms SerpApi serves an llms.txt at serpapi.com/llms.txt with a product summary. Agent-oriented markdown versions of the docs are also served, such as /search-api.md with frontmatter, and many other doc pages are available as .md, so an agent can be pointed directly at them. Missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and evidence of how deep and complete the llms.txt index is.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Use SerpApi's Google Flights API to scrape Google Flights information.
